data.standardized_narrative: The report references material natural catastrophe exposure which materially affected the 2017 and 2018 years of account (notably Hurricanes Michael and Florence). The document does not provide a clearly extractable GROSS prior-year movement figure in the available images; therefore no quantified gross prior-year reserve movement is reported here. Narrative suggests mixed prior-year impacts driven primarily by natural catastrophe activity and large losses.
raw_causal_phrases: The SPA has material natural catastrophe exposure and hence the loss ratios particularly impacted by the 2017 and 2018 years of account.
data.data_quality_notes: Document provided as low-resolution rotated scanned images. Key numeric fields (gross claims outstanding at 1-Jan-2019 and gross prior year movement) could not be reliably read from the images. Some named events (Hurricane Michael, Hurricane Florence) and a gross written premium total (41,552 $000) were legible; most balance sheet and movement tables were not unambiguously extractable. Where gross prior-year movement (GROSS insurance liabilities column) was not found, fields are left null. If higher-quality/unaltered PDF pages are provided, precise numeric extraction can be attempted.
